datasets.name: NASA POWER Daily Agroclimatology
datasets.role_in_app: LIVE MODEL INPUT — Drives daily ET0, soil-water bucket balance, flowering heat spikes, frost risk, and root-zone soil moisture anomaly.
datasets.limitations: Grid-cell averages (~50 km) smooth localized hailstorms, micro-topography, and canal seepage.

datasets.name: NASA GIBS MODIS Terra Corrected Reflectance (True Color)
datasets.role_in_app: MAP CONTEXT LAYER — Lets farmers visually inspect regional green-up, bare-field periods, and seasonal transitions.
datasets.limitations: Optical imagery affected by monsoon cloud cover; visual context only (NDVI not ingested into the deterministic water-balance engine).

datasets.name: NASA GIBS SMAP L4 Analyzed Root-Zone Soil Moisture
datasets.role_in_app: MAP CONTEXT LAYER — Shows regional root-zone moisture gradients across districts; model uses NASA POWER GWETROOT + FAO-56 bucket.
datasets.limitations: Assimilated ~9 km product cannot resolve individual 1-hectare field bunds or drip zones.

datasets.name: NASA GIBS GPM IMERG Precipitation Rate
datasets.role_in_app: MAP CONTEXT LAYER — Visualizes satellite-derived rainfall swaths across the region.
datasets.limitations: Snapshot precipitation rate layer for spatial context; 20-year water balance uses NASA POWER PRECTOTCORR daily totals.

datasets.name: ISRIC SoilGrids v2.0 + Regional Soil AWC Lookup
datasets.role_in_app: LIVE MODEL INPUT — Sets soil water-holding bucket capacity (AWC mm/m). Uses 2.5s live REST query with documented regional fallback.
datasets.limitations: Does not detect hardpan compaction, local salinity patches, or recent organic manure applications.

datasets.name: ECOSTRESS LST / Landsat NDVI / GEDI Biomass (Harmonization Context)
datasets.temporal_coverage: Scientific reference only (not queried live in request path)
datasets.role_in_app: SCIENTIFIC ROADMAP — Documented in the Data Fusion guide to explain resolution harmonization; NOT claimed as live model inputs.
datasets.limitations: Excluded from live synchronous analysis to guarantee <3s deterministic response without external STAC latency.

disclaimer: KinField supports farmer and Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) decision-making using historical satellite-reanalysis weather and soil water balance. It does NOT replace local soil testing, borewell/canal checks, pest scouting, or extension agronomist advice.
